description: Vehicle reports 11.8V battery voltage under accessory load with sluggish ignition start.
expectedRootCause: Battery undercharge or cell degradation below 12V normal operating threshold.
expectedAction: Perform battery load test and alternator charging circuit inspection.

description: Continuous engine coolant temperature spikes exceeding 103C with low coolant warning.
expectedRootCause: Cooling system failure / low coolant leading to imminent engine overheat.
expectedAction: Immediate vehicle shutdown, inspect radiator, thermostat, and coolant level.

description: Front left tire pressure reads 28 PSI against recommended 32 PSI cold pressure.
expectedRootCause: Minor tire under-inflation due to ambient temperature change or slow leak.
expectedAction: Inflate tire to recommended 32 PSI and inspect tread for punctures.
